description: This Kotlin file is a Dagger module definition named SyncModule. It provides dependency bindings for synchronization status management within an Android app, specifically binding implementations for SyncManager and SyncSubscriber interfaces.

classes.name: SyncModule
classes.description: An abstract Dagger module that binds implementations to interfaces for dependency injection related to synchronization features.

methods.name: bindsSyncStatusMonitor
methods.description: Provides a binding of WorkManagerSyncManager as the implementation of SyncManager.

methods.name: bindsSyncSubscriber
methods.description: Provides a binding of StubSyncSubscriber as the implementation of SyncSubscriber.
